items.modality_rationale: NFE2 is a sequence-specific DNA-binding protein (transcription factors), a class with no useful small-molecule surface, so the route is an edit of the gene or its enhancer
items.statement: Loss or inhibition of NFE2 increases fetal hemoglobin in human erythroid cells.

items.modality_rationale: VHL has no protein class implying a small molecule, so an edit is assumed as the conservative route
items.statement: Loss or inhibition of VHL increases fetal hemoglobin in human erythroid cells.

items.statement: Loss or inhibition of DNMT1 increases fetal hemoglobin in human erythroid cells.
